channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Education Accolades
item.description: Upper Iowa University names LeRoy Tyson Stevens and Gavin Sweeney to its Fall 2025 Dean’s List

item.title: Hormel appoints company’s First Chief Technology Officer
item.description: Hormel Foods names veteran tech leader Donald Monk as its first chief technology officer, leading enterprise technology, digital and data strategy starting March 23.

item.title: Austin man returning to prison following sentencing for domestic assault
item.description: Marcus Antwan Martin had been out of prison for just eight days when he was arrested during October 2025 incident

item.title: All area wrestlers eliminated from Class A boys state wrestling meet
item.description: Eight area wrestlers bow out of the Class A boys state meet at Grand Casino Arena, with Westfield and GMLOS athletes finishing seasons with records from 22-23 to 42-9.

item.title: GMLOS girls still have three wrestlers in state bracket
item.description: Three GMLOS girls wrestlers stay alive in the Class A state bracket at Grand Casino Arena after key wins by Chloe Hubbard, Brandy Christenson and Kloe Meyer.

item.title: APS Board casts eyes forward toward needed renovations on district facilities
item.description: Members to consider using board authorized funding to approach air quality, roofs, parking lots.

item.title: Wings score late goal off face-off to beat Bruins
item.description: Cooper Anderson's late faceoff goal lifted the Aberdeen Wings to a 2-1 win over division-leading Austin Bruins at Riverside Arena; Siamion Marshchanok scored Austin's lone goal.

item.title: Shorthanded Packer boys close season with loss at Mayo
item.description: Shorthanded Austin boys fall 84-45 at Mayo in regular-season finale; two seniors sidelined as Packers turn focus to Section 1AAA tournament opener Wednesday.

item.title: Blue Devil men advance to Region XIII championship
item.description: Riverland men top Anoka-Ramsey 85-75 behind Camden Fearon's 19 and Joe Poyser's double-double to reach the Region XIII title game vs. Ridgewater on Sunday in Anoka.

item.title: Austin's Dahl advances in two events at state swim meet
item.description: Austin’s Brent Dahl reaches Class AA state finals in 100 backstroke and 200 IM consolation; Packer 200 medley relay narrowly misses advancing at U of M prelims.
